verdict.rationale: Docs and a verified probe clearly show the project-local mode: `npx skills add ... --copy` writes editable SKILL.md files into the repo's `.claude/skills/` folder that you own and commit (mattpocock-skills-docs-2, -24, -31, probe-rt-1). There's also a 'managed, read-only bundle that updates when I ship' subscribe mode and a Claude Code marketplace plugin install (`claude plugins install mattpocock-skills`), which hints at a non-repo-local, possibly user-wide install path, but no evidence explicitly confirms this installs once per-user and applies across all projects. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/testing of a user-global install location, and confirmation that the same install choice is presented as a scope toggle rather than two separate distribution mechanisms.
